title: Prometheus-alpha v0.5: memory through cell turnover, long delay and minimal fragments
status: Locked before any v0.5 experiment on a confirmatory rule. No new rules. No pilots; a code smoke test at n = 4 on pilot rule S102 checked output shapes only.
code: src/prometheus/v5.py (imports the locked v0.1 code unchanged)
rules: E0, E1, S0, S1, B0, B1, F0, F1 (all frozen)

H25.claim: Turnover: after conditioning and the delay, every 20 steps for 200 steps 10% of cells chosen at random die (mask seed 1); the intact worm still remembers

H26.claim: Long delay: the memory survives 300 steps without any presentation

H27.claim: Minimal anterior fragment: keeping only sites 12-19 (8 cells) and regrowing for 64 steps yields a worm that remembers

H28.claim: Minimal posterior fragment: keeping only sites 24-31 (8 cells) and regrowing for 64 steps yields a worm that remembers

decision_rules.family: H25-H28 in each rule; Holm at alpha 0.05; SESOI 0.10; replicated = supported in both rules of a family

predictions.H25: all eight rules: supported (the rule repairs lost cells from their neighbours)
predictions.H27: S, B, F: supported (the copy sits at the neck). E: not supported
predictions.H28: F1: supported (distributed copy). F0, S, B, E: not supported
